properties.name: Add OneNote icon to notification area (User)
properties.description: Checks/Unchecks the option ''Place OneNote icon in the notification area of the taskbar''.

properties.name: Admin-Controlled Migration to New Outlook (User)
properties.description:
This policy controls the ability of IT admins to initiate the migration of users from classic Outlook to new Outlook.

If you enable this policy setting, IT admins will start the process to switch users from classic Outlook to new Outlook.

If you disable this policy setting, the migration process to new Outlook will be stopped, keeping users on their current version of Outlook without transitioning to new Outlook.

If you do not set this policy setting, the migration process to new Outlook will not start, and users that have not migrated will remain on classic Outlook.

Note: IT admins can also define intervals for re-initiating the migration process for users who revert to classic Outlook from new Outlook. This is managed through the NewOutlookAutoMigrationRetryIntervals policy, offering a tailored strategy for transitioning users based on organizational requirements and user feedback.

properties.name: Default unit of measurement used in OneNote (User)
properties.description: Sets the value in the option ''Measurement units''.

properties.name: Disable embedded files (User)
properties.description: To disable the ability to embed files on a OneNote page, so people cannot transmit files that might not be caught by anti-virus software, etc. Note: This policy will only limit embedded files in the OneNote UI, if a page has an embedded file OneNote will still sync and replicate the embedded files in the file system.

properties.name: Disable OCR (User)
properties.description: This policy turns off the OneNote image optical character recognition (OCR) feature. The OCR feature allows OneNote to automatically scan through images to find text that will appear in search results.

properties.name: Disable OneNote screen clipping notifications (User)
properties.description: Turns off all of the OneNote screen clipping notifications.

properties.name: Disable OneNote Screen Clippings (User)
properties.description: Disables the screen clipping feature in OneNote.

properties.name: Disable online mode for Get Diagnostics. (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines whether online mode for Get Diagnostics is allowed. Enabling this setting will block Get Diagnostics feature from sending authentication and diagnostics logs to our service.
 Users will now go through offline mode. We will collect all the logs and store them in the Downloads folder of the user. This user can contact support and decide if they want to send us the logs.

properties.name: Disable Outlook features in the Feedback tab under the File menu in Outlook (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines whether Outlook features will be displayed in the Feedback tab under the File menu in Outlook.

If you enable this policy setting, then Outlook features will not be displayed in the Feedback tab under the File menu in Outlook.

properties.name: Disable Outlook Mobile Hyperlink (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines if the Outlook Mobile Hyperlink is shown in Account Settings.

If you enable this policy setting, users will be unable to view the Outlook Mobile Hyperlink in Account Settings.

properties.name: Disable Outlook tenant admin notifications (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines if tenant admins can receive support notifications in Outlook.

Default (0): Tenant admins who are signed in will receive status updates about potential issues and fixes that are impacting their tenant.

If you enable this setting, tenant admins who are signed in won't receive status updates about potential issues and fixes that are impacting their tenant.

properties.name: Disable Preview Place. (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines whether the Preview Place feature is allowed. Enabling this setting will block the Preview Place feature from being available.
 Users will no longer be able to preview and provide feedback on upcoming changes in Outlook.
 Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Office 365 ProPlus.

properties.name: Disable Preview Place. (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines whether the Preview Place feature is allowed. Enabling this setting will block the Preview Place feature from being available.
 Users will no longer be able to preview and provide feedback on upcoming changes in Outlook.
 Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise.

properties.name: Disable support diagnostics in Outlook (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines if Outlook can communicate client information on failure to support services with the intent of diagnosing the issue or making the information available to support to help with the diagnosis/resolution of the issue and/or provide contextual error messaging to the user.

If you enable this policy setting, then Outlook will not communicate client information on failure to support services.

properties.name: Disable support ticket creation in Outlook (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines if an Outlook support ticket can be created in Outlook.

If you enable this policy setting, users will be unable to create a support ticket in Outlook.

properties.name: Disable the new Sticky Notes experience (User)
properties.description:
This policy controls the ability of users to access the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

If you enable this policy setting, users will be unable to access the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

If you disable this policy setting, users can access the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

If you do not set this policy setting, users can access the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

Note: This policy does not affect the classic Microsoft Sticky Notes app available on the Microsoft Store. Additionally, disabling or not setting this policy does not guarantee access to the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

properties.name: Disable the new Sticky Notes experience (User)
properties.description:
This policy controls the ability of users to access the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

If you enable this policy setting, users will be unable to access the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

If you disable this policy setting, users can access the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

If you do not set this policy setting, users can access the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

Note: This policy does not affect the classic Microsoft Sticky Notes app available on the Microsoft Store. Additionally, disabling or not setting this policy does not guarantee access to the new Sticky Notes experiences from OneNote.

properties.name: Disable the Outlook crash notification when Outlook restarts. (User)
properties.description: This policy setting determines if the Outlook crash notification on restart is allowed. Enabling this setting will block Outlook crash notification on restart.

properties.name: Disable the Support tab under the File menu in Outlook (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines whether the Support tab will be displayed under the File menu in Outlook.

If you enable this policy setting, then the Support tab will not be displayed under the File menu in Outlook.

properties.name: Do not display the reading pane (User)
properties.description: By default, the Reading Pane is enabled only in the mail module and located on the right hand side of the window. This setting allows you to disable the reading pane.

properties.name: Do not download photos from the Active Directory (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether user photos will be downloaded from the Active Directory (if available). 

If you enable this policy setting, photos will not be downloaded.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, photos will be downloaded.

properties.name: Embedded File Size Limit (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting enables you to specify the maximum embedded file size that users can insert directly into a OneNote notebook on a SharePoint server.
 
If you enable this policy setting, you can increase or decrease the default maximum file size of 50 MB. 

If you increase this value, users can insert larger files directly into the notebook, but this may reduce server performance. 

If you decrease this value, users can only insert smaller files directly into the notebook, which may improve server performance if OneNote sync is generating a lot of traffic.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, users cannot insert a file larger than 50MB inserted into a OneNote notebook. Instead, the file is uploaded to a SharePoint folder and inserted as a hyperlink into the notebook.

properties.name: Embedded Files Blocked Extensions (User)
properties.description: To disable the ability of the users in your organization from being able to open a file attachment of a specific file type from a Microsoft OneNote page, add the extensions you want to disable using this format: ".ext1;.ext2;" If you want to disable the opening of any attachment from a OneNote page, see the Disable embedded files policy. You cannot block embedded audio and video recordings (WMA & WMV) with this policy instead refer to the Disable embedded files policy.

properties.name: Empty the Deleted Items folder when Outlook closes (User)
properties.description: By default, the Deleted Items folder is not emptied when users exit Outlook. By enabling this setting, you can change this behavior so that the Deleted Items folder is emptied when Outlook closes.

properties.name: Enable OneNote Sensitivity Labels (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether Purview Sensitivity Label capabilities can be enabled for OneNote Sections.

If you enable this policy, users can use supported Purview features, such as manual labeling, label removal, or default labels, to apply sensitivity labels to OneNote sections and help protect sensitive information. At this time, mandatory labels, auto labeling, and dynamic watermarking are not supported.

If you disable this policy, users won't be able to apply, change or remove Sensitivity Labels in OneNote Sections.

If you do not configure this policy setting, users won't be able to apply, change or remove Sensitivity Labels in OneNote Sections.

properties.name: Hide photo link (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting configures the link to the user's My Site (when detected) where the user's photo can be uploaded. This link is under the File tab. 

If you enable this policy setting, the link is not visible.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, the link is visible.

properties.name: Hide the “Try the new Outlook” toggle in Outlook (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether the “Try the new Outlook” toggle is displayed in Outlook.

If you enable this policy setting, the toggle for “Try the new Outlook” will be hidden and users will not have the ability to switch between the existing and new Outlook experiences.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, the toggle for “Try the new Outlook” will be displayed.

Note: This policy only applies to subscription-based Microsoft 365 Apps.

properties.name: Hide the Office Store button (User)
properties.description:
The Office Store button allows users to get apps for Outlook from the Home tab in the ribbon.

If you enable this policy setting, the Office Store button doesn’t appear on the Home tab in the ribbon.

If you disable or don’t configure this policy setting, the Office Store button appears on the Home tab in the ribbon.

properties.name: Interval between new Outlook migration attempts (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls the interval between new Outlook migration attempts.

If you don't set this or set this to 0 (default value), classic Outlook will stop executing "New Outlook auto migration" after the user toggles back to classic Outlook for Windows.

If you set this to 1, classic Outlook will show a blocking prompt on each app launch, which will attempt to switch the user to the new Outlook app.

If you set this to N (2 - 9900) value, "New Outlook auto migration" will be re-initiated N days after the user toggles back to classic Outlook.

Note: This policy only applies to subscription-based Microsoft 365 Apps.

properties.name: Interval between new Outlook migration attempts (User)

If you set this to 1, classic Outlook will show a blocking prompt on each app launch, which will attempt to switch the user to the new Outlook app.

If you set this to N (2 - 9900) value, "New Outlook auto migration" will be re-initiated N days after the user toggles back to classic Outlook.

Note: This policy only applies to subscription-based Microsoft 365 Apps.

properties.name: Make Outlook the default program for E-mail, Contacts, and Calendar (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether Outlook is the default program for e-mail, contacts, and calendar services.

If you enable this policy setting, the "Make Outlook the default program for E-mail, Contacts, and Calendar" check box on the General tab of the Office Center is selected and users cannot change it.

If you disable this policy setting, users cannot make Outlook the default program for these services.

If you do not configure this policy setting, Outlook is made the default program for e-mail, contacts, and calendar services when it is installed, although users can designate other programs as the default programs for these services.

properties.name: Manage automatic setup of classic Outlook accounts in new Outlook (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to manage whether classic Outlook automatically sets up user accounts and settings in new Outlook.

If you enable this policy setting, automatic setup of user accounts and settings in new Outlook is allowed and cannot be changed by the user.

If you disable this policy setting, automatic setup of user accounts and settings in new Outlook is not allowed and cannot be changed by the user.

If you don't configure this policy setting, users can manage the setting themselves. Automatic setup is enabled by default.

properties.name: Manage user setting for new Outlook automatic migration (User)
properties.description:
This policy allows you to manage the user setting for enabling or disabling automatic migration to the new Outlook app. Automatic migration could be admin-driven (enabled through 'Admin-Controlled migration to New Outlook' policy), or Microsoft-driven.

When applied, this policy controls whether the user can be switched to the new Outlook app automatically or retains control over the setting.

If you set this policy to 1 (Set to 1), the user setting controlling automatic migration is enabled. Automatic migration to the new Outlook app is allowed, and the user cannot change this setting.

If you set this policy to 2 (Set to 2), the user setting controlling automatic migration is disabled. Automatic migration to the new Outlook app is not allowed, and the user cannot change this setting.

If you set this policy to 0 (Set to 0) or don't configure this policy (default), the user setting for automatic migration is not controlled by the policy, allowing the user to manage it themselves. This user setting for automatic migration is enabled by default.

Multiplier for background sync interval for notebooks stored on SharePoint (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to increase the interval between background polls of a SharePoint site for changes to notebooks.

If you enable this policy setting, OneNote will poll SharePoint less frequently for changes to whole notebooks. Intervals are multiplied by the entered value, a positive integer value from 1 to 10. Larger intervals will slow notebook sync but reduce server load.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, OneNote will sync notebooks at the default rate (multiplier value of 1).

Note: This policy setting only applies to volume licensed versions of Office 2016 that use Windows Installer (MSI), such as Office Professional Plus 2016 and Office Standard 2016.

properties.name: Multiplier for foreground sync interval for the currently viewed section stored on SharePoint (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to increase the interval between foreground polls of a SharePoint site for changes to the currently viewed section.

If you enable this policy setting, OneNote will poll SharePoint less frequently for changes to the currently viewed section. Intervals are multiplied by the entered value, a positive integer value from 1 to 10. Larger intervals will slow section sync but reduce server load.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, OneNote will sync the currently viewed section at the default rate (multiplier value of 1).

Note: This policy setting only applies to volume licensed versions of Office 2016 that use Windows Installer (MSI), such as Office Professional Plus 2016 and Office Standard 2016.

properties.name: Multiplier for Presence sync interval for notebooks stored on SharePoint (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to increase the interval between polls to SharePoint to determine active users of notebooks. OneNote will sync notebooks at a faster rate when other users are interacting with a notebook.

If you enable this policy setting, OneNote will poll SharePoint less frequently to determine if there are other users currently interacting with notebooks. Intervals are multiplied by the entered value, a positive integer value from 1 to 10. Larger intervals will slow detection of concurrent users in notebooks but reduce server load.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, OneNote will poll for active users of notebooks at the default rate (multiplier value of 1).

Note: This policy setting only applies to volume licensed versions of Office 2016 that use Windows Installer (MSI), such as Office Professional Plus 2016 and Office Standard 2016.

Notebook Presence (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting enables or disables the Notebook Presence feature in OneNote, which broadcasts user presence within a notebook and enables real-time synchronization for users who are editing the same page. Note: Any change to this policy does not take effect until OneNote is restarted.

If you enable or do not configure this policy setting, users are notified when they are editing the same page in a notebook as another user. OneNote also enters real-time sync when it discovers multiple users editing the same page. 

If you disable this policy setting, users are not notified when they are editing the same page in a notebook as another user. OneNote does not enter real-time sync when multiple users are editing the same page.

properties.name: Number of days before warning that server is inaccessible (User)
properties.description: Set the number of days until OneNote warns that the server is inaccessible and prompts for a new location for the affected files.

properties.name: Prompt for the client certificate when multiple certificates match.
properties.description:
This policy controls whether the user is prompted to select a client certificate when more than one certificate matches AutoSelectCertificateForUrls.
If this policy is set to Enabled, the user is prompted to select a client certificate whenever the auto-selection policy matches multiple certificates.
If this policy is set to Disabled or not set, the user may only be prompted when no certificate matches the auto-selection.

properties.name: Prompt for the client certificate when multiple certificates match. (User)
properties.description:
This policy controls whether the user is prompted to select a client certificate when more than one certificate matches AutoSelectCertificateForUrls.
If this policy is set to Enabled, the user is prompted to select a client certificate whenever the auto-selection policy matches multiple certificates.
If this policy is set to Disabled or not set, the user may only be prompted when no certificate matches the auto-selection.

properties.name: Reading Pane (User)
properties.description: Checks/Unchecks the option "Mark items as read when viewed in the Reading Pane" in the Reading Pane dialog box.

properties.name: Recommend the Microsoft Outlook Extension (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether Windows 10 users of the Outlook app and the Outlook web app will see a recommendation to install the new Microsoft Outlook extension for Microsoft Edge. If a user chooses to click the recommendation, they will be taken to the Microsoft Outlook extension page where they can choose to install this web-based, productivity add on. Your users can dismiss the recommendation and will only see the recommendation twice. If your users choose to install the extension, they will be able to access their mail, calendar, contacts, and tasks from an icon in Microsoft Edge without requiring that they open another browser tab. The extension is a “mini” version of Outlook on the web which operates as a one-click flyout from the browser header.

In the future, Microsoft may release a version of this extension for the Chrome browser. Microsoft will respect this policy for future promotions of a Chrome extension, as well.

If you enable or do not configure this policy setting, the recommendation will be presented to the user.

If you disable this policy setting, the recommendation will not be presented to the user.

Note: This policy setting only applies to subscription versions of Office, such as Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise and Outlook web app.

For more information, see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2165458

properties.name: Set UNC interval to poll for changes on file servers (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to change the synchronization interval at which OneNote will poll for changes on the server. When OneNote synchronizes a notebook on UNC, also known as SMB or Windows File shares, OneNote will receive notifications from the file server as well as poll the server looking for new updates on the server.

By making the interval faster it will make OneNote synchronize faster, but it also might cause performance issues on the server.

If you enable this policy setting, you may specify the number of seconds OneNote will poll.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, OneNote will automatically poll every 30 seconds.

properties.name: SharePoint sync interval for notebooks stored on SharePoint (User)
properties.description: Limits the number of times OneNote polls a SharePoint site for changes to a section. Enter the sync interval in seconds.

properties.name: Show Mini Toolbar on selection (User)
properties.description: Disabling this policy setting will result in Mini Toolbar not being displayed on text selection. By default, Mini Toolbar on selection is enabled and its visibility can be changed via a setting in the Editor Options dialog box.

properties.name: Single key reading using spacebar (User)
Sort folders alphabetically (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether users can rearrange their folders in Outlook.

If you enable this policy setting, users cannot rearrange their folders. The folders are displayed alphabetically.

If you disable this policy setting, users can rearrange their folders, but are not able to turn automatic alphabetical sorting back on from the Ribbon. 

If you do not configure this policy setting, users can rearrange their folders, and turn automatic alphabetical sorting back on from the Ribbon.

properties.name: Specify default unit of measurement: (User)
Turn off Coming Soon (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether Coming Soon is available to users. Coming Soon provides information in an Office app, such as Word or Excel, about upcoming feature changes to that app and lets users try out those changes ahead of time. By default, Coming Soon is available to users.

 If you enable this policy setting, Coming Soon is turned off and isn't available to users.

 If you disable or don't configure this policy setting, Coming Soon is available to users.

properties.name: Turn off OneNote auto-linked note taking (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting turns off the OneNote auto note taking feature which allows you to take notes on items such as webpages, Word documents, etc. OneNote will automatically record what pages or document you were viewing when you took this note.

If you enable this policy setting, OneNote will not automatically link notes when the user tries to turn on this feature.

If you disable or do not enable this policy, OneNote will automatically link notes when the user tries to turn on this feature.

properties.name: Turn off support diagnostics in OneNote (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls whether OneNote sends client information to support services on failure.

Sending client information to support services on failure can help diagnose the issue, provide resolution steps, or show contextual error messaging to the user.

If you enable this policy setting, OneNote won’t send client information to support services on failure.

If you disable or don’t configure this policy setting, OneNote will send client information to support services on failure.

Note: This policy setting only applies to Version 2207 and later of OneNote.
